headline: Is Henry Schein (HSIC) Still Cheap After A 37% Run?
summary: Henry Schein stock has delivered a 37.5% return over the past year, yet the valuation picture is more mixed, with the Discounted Cash Flow (DCF) intrinsic value estimate indicating the shares may be trading at a sizeable discount while earnings based multiples look closer to fair. Henry Schein's 37.5% one year return suggests investors have already priced in a meaningful improvement in the story, so additional upside may depend on how the fundamentals evolve from here.
